principle: Visual decisions are completed before voiceover. Phase 3 only times and assembles approved Phase-1 assets.

scenes.visualIntent: Hook must instantly show the conflict between studying and the phone, not merely a person at a desk.
noGo: random phone close-up without study context

shots.description: Top-down or close study desk: notebook open, learner actively writing, smartphone beside notes lights up or is checked, causing the hand to stop studying.
queries: student studying desk smartphone distraction close up

shots.description: Minimal split comparison: 10 minutes study on one side versus 60 minutes scrolling on the other, with a rapidly moving phone-feed indicator.

scenes.visualIntent: Show that notifications are designed to pull attention repeatedly.

shots.description: Generic smartphone silhouette with notification bubbles appearing one after another around it; no real app branding.
Hand interrupts reading or note-taking to pick up a phone after a notification.
queries: hand picks up phone while studying

scenes.visualIntent: Make context switching visible and fast: task, phone, task, phone.

shots.description: Three large panels labeled only with icons: notebook, laptop document, smartphone. A focus marker jumps rapidly between them.
Close-up sequence of the same person alternating between handwritten notes, laptop and smartphone at one desk.
queries: switching between laptop phone notebook studying
student multitasking phone laptop close up
study desk phone laptop notebook hands

scenes.visualIntent: Show the recovery cost after interruption rather than another generic distracted-student shot.
noGo: person holding head with no study context

shots.description: Phone is placed face-down; hand returns to notebook and searches several lines/pages to find the previous place.
queries: returning to notes after phone distraction
student searching notes page close up

shots.description: Simple focus meter drops to zero after an interruption and slowly climbs back instead of instantly returning to full focus.

scenes.visualIntent: Explain slower learning and weaker memory through a clean visual, not fake neuroscience stock.

shots.description: Two progress bars compare uninterrupted study versus repeated interruptions; interrupted bar advances much more slowly.
Close-up of learner rereading the same lines or correcting notes after losing track.

scenes.visualIntent: Show automatic phone checking as a habit loop.
noGo: person intentionally making a phone call

shots.description: Hand reflexively reaches for a phone beside study materials, unlocks it, then starts scrolling without a deliberate transition.
Tiny sequence: clock icon -> unlock icon -> endless-scroll icon, emphasizing how a quick check expands into an app session.

scenes.visualIntent: Transition from willpower to environment design.

shots.description: Willpower icon faces repeated notification arrows and loses; then the phone is physically moved outside a boundary around the study desk.

scenes.visualIntent: Show three concrete actions exactly as spoken: distance, notifications off, only needed tools open.

shots.description: Phone is deliberately placed into a drawer, bag or outside the immediate desk area.
Brand-neutral mock phone settings screen where notification toggles are switched off.
Mock laptop browser closes multiple tabs until only one learning document remains.
Large clean timer starts at 25:00, followed by a short 05:00 break card; notebook remains visible in layout.
Focused writing at a desk with a visible generic timer nearby if available.

scenes.visualIntent: Show single-tasking: one task fills the frame and the phone is absent.

shots.description: Tight calm close-ups of one notebook or one learning document; hand writes continuously; no phone in frame.
queries: focused studying notebook no phone close up

shots.description: Icons for chat, scrolling and extra tabs fade out, leaving one task card centered.

scenes.visualIntent: Show that focus comes from environment setup, not motivation.

shots.description: Before/after study environment: left side has phone, notification icons and many tabs; right side removes each distraction one by one.

scenes.visualIntent: End calmly with a credible focused study result, not an exaggerated success shot.

shots.description: Calm completed study desk: several finished notes, hand closes notebook, phone remains out of reach or inside a bag.
queries: finished studying notes desk phone away

shots.description: Final minimal line: fewer distractions -> more usable focus, with no motivational slogan.
